source.name: Staffing, recruitment and executive-search firms, compiled by the RoboApply team
source.notes: A firm is listed only when it publicly describes its own business as staffing, recruitment, labour dispatch or executive search. Names are matched after company-name normalization (case, width and legal suffixes removed). Listing means a posting by this firm is an agency post; it says nothing about the quality of the firm. Latin-script names of six or more letters and Chinese names of three or more characters also match as a leading phrase ("Randstad USA", "万宝盛华企业管理咨询"); shorter names match only exactly.
